items.title: What is Mythical Void?
items.objective: Make the hatch-to-bond experience immediately understandable through authentic gameplay.
items.audience: General players and adult/guardian trust audiences

items.title: The world was alive
items.objective: Demonstrate player-led restoration and the Project Beacon premise without implying pre-rendered art is gameplay.
items.audience: Narrative, adventure, creature, and family audiences

items.title: What the creature remembers
items.objective: Show one implemented memory with an explicit boundary rather than claiming unrestricted intelligence.
items.audience: Players, parents/guardians, creators, and responsible-AI audiences

items.title: How Mythical uses AI responsibly
items.objective: Explain actual generated-media systems, age gates, providers, data boundaries, fallbacks, and human-authored dialogue.
items.audience: Parents/guardians, industry, partners, press, and responsible-AI peers

items.title: What changed because people played
items.objective: Close the feedback loop with an evidenced product or company change.
items.audience: Players, parents/guardians, and the wider studio community

items.title: Project Beacon introduction
items.objective: Create a concise story-led introduction using only approved current-access and product claims.
items.audience: General players and adult/guardian discovery audiences

items.title: Why Mythical Void is different
items.objective: Explain the genetics system, Phaser 3 browser world, and bounded AI cinematic layer without hype or unsupported promises.
items.audience: Adult players, parents and guardians, creators, partners, and games press; not child-targeted advertising
